selection_policy: One named analyte with full 9872-sample coverage in pinned publisher reference workbook; chosen before target counts. Other analytes and metabolites are outside this task. Not selected by accuracy or class balance.
experiment: Retrospective supervised association study of publisher original-extraction detection in the released 2024 cohort. No operational pre-assay or future-year deployment claim.
observation_time_precision: DATE, conservative day after official archive posting
target_meaning: Publisher original-extraction imidacloprid detection (O=1) versus validated well-recovered nondetect (ND=0). NP marginal-performing nondetect and R re-extraction excluded. Nondetect is assay-relative, not zero residue or safe food.
unit_of_observation: One unambiguous original imidacloprid analytical result for one PDP 2024 sample; at most one row per sample.

questionable_features.pdp_variety_text: Free-form variety text, ambiguous N/A tokens and possible identifiers; withheld from default matrix.

recommended_split.policy: Whole collection days in chronological order, all rows of each sample together. Dataset has one row per sample. Fit all transforms on training only. Require both classes per partition; stop if unsupported.
recommended_split.rationale: Later collection-period holdout probes within-2024 drift without analytical sample overlap. All labels released together: this is retrospective temporal validation, not evidence a model could be trained during 2024. No result availability at earlier training boundaries is claimed.
recommended_split.secondary: GROUPED sample holdout for within-cohort comparison; GEOGRAPHIC only after source location semantics reviewed. No facility IDs; cannot prove lot/farm independence.

blocked_tasks.BIOLOGICAL: BLOCKED_PENDING_FSIS: official raw pathogen samples and matching dictionary not acquired.
blocked_tasks.COLD_CHAIN: BLOCKED_PENDING_SENSOR_DATA: no validated specimen-linked storage/sensor/microbial series.
blocked_tasks.CHEMICAL_RESIDUE_REGRESSION: PARTIAL: censored targets and quantification policy not approved. Detection only.
